pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal patches with smooth edge gradients and rounded vertices. Spatial area of individual patches decreases significantly toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: High-contrast network of light-colored pathways with consistent pixel thickness across the flank. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate, forming a continuous topological grid.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, stiff mane visible along the dorsal neck with a fine-grained, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background.
